Things that make a man
underrated but impressive
He can cook a full dinner for six. No stress, no takeaway backup. Feeding people well is a rare and generous skill that people remember for years.
He stays calm in an emergency. A cut hand, a car breakdown, a lost child at the market. While others panic, he quietly does what needs to be done.
He reads more than he talks about reading. No big announcements, just real knowledge that shows up in calm, thoughtful conversations.
He keeps his friendships for decades. The same friends from school, still close. Long friendships show loyalty, patience and real character.
He learns something every day. I do five minutes a day of history, art or science, and quiet curiosity is the most underrated habit I know.
slides.texte_sophia: I do five minutes a day on a micro-learning app like the Sophia app. History, art, science. Quiet curiosity is the most underrated habit I know.

slides.texte_overlay: He fixes things without being asked. The squeaky door, the wobbly table, the bike with a flat. Practical help speaks louder than any compliment.
He never needs to win the argument. He listens, makes his point once, and lets it go. Calm confidence like that is impressive in any room.
